overview: Rozana Grocery is a mobile-first Indian grocery and daily-essentials delivery app for browsing, ordering and tracking grocery, personal-care and household products.
features: Browse 27 grocery, personal-care and household categories
Search products with category and price filters
Product cards with brand, pack size, price, discount and wishlist
Cart with quantity controls, coupons and delivery charges
Checkout with saved addresses, Cash on Delivery or Online Payment
Order tracking from Order Placed to Delivered
User account with profile, orders, addresses, wishlist and coupons
Admin panel for products, categories, orders, coupons and sales
